verses.text: His foundation is in the holy mountains.
lines: His foundation is in the holy mountains.

verses.text: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
lines: Yahweh loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

verses.text: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God.
lines: Glorious things are spoken about you, city of God.

verses.text: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me. Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia: “This one was born there.”
lines: I will record Rahab and Babylon among those who acknowledge me.
Behold, Philistia, Tyre, and also Ethiopia:

verses.text: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;” the Most High himself will establish her.
lines: Yes, of Zion it will be said, “This one and that one was born in her;”
the Most High himself will establish her.

verses.text: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples, “This one was born there.”
lines: Yahweh will count, when he writes up the peoples,

verses.text: Those who sing as well as those who dance say, “All my springs are in you.”
lines: Those who sing as well as those who dance say,
